Definition: from G2664; reposing down, i.e. (by Hebraism) abode:--rest.
BiblicalUsage: Rest is the abode God promises and the place He will not give to the unbelieving, and we who have believed do enter into rest, so we must labour to enter it. Heaven is His throne and earth is His footstool, and God asks what house men will build Him when He made them all. The rest is both a promise to take and a warning to heed, and the same chapter holds both.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the rest of God is entered by faith and missed by unbelief, and the line between them is the hearing of His voice today. I hold that labouring to enter rest is no contradiction, because the labour is believing, and the rest is His.
